typical_devices: Volkswagen/BMW/Mercedes/Renault RKE fob (433.92 MHz); Bosch Smart Home; Somfy RTS roller shutter remote; Oregon Scientific WMR89 weather station; Bresser 7-in-1 weather sensor; ELRO AB600 alarm; Yale Easy Fit alarm; Nexa/ANSLUT wireless switch; FS20 home automation; Chacon DIO wireless plugs; Flipper Zero Sub-GHz (OOK/ASK/FSK read+replay); HackRF One + SDR#; RTL-SDR + rtl_433; Yard Stick One
modulation: OOK / ASK (most common); FSK (some sensors); Manchester encoding common
power_limit: 10 mW e.r.p. <10% DC; 1 mW e.r.p. 100% DC; 500 mW ≤1% DC (EU sub-bands)
regulatory_ref: ERC/REC 70-03 Annex 1 / ETSI EN 300 220-1/2 / ITU RR 5.138 5.150
notes: Central freq 433.92 MHz most common. Protocol zoo: rtl_433 decodes 200+ device types. Key tools: Flipper Zero (GUI decode+replay), rtl_433 (CLI), URH (Universal Radio Hacker), SDR# + DSD. NOT a primary ISM band in USA — US devices use 315/915 MHz.

typical_devices: Motorola TLKR T80 Extreme; Motorola XT420/XT460 (digital dPMR); Midland G7 Pro; Kenwood TK-3401D (dPMR446); Cobra AM245; Baofeng BF-888S (not PMR446 compliant but often used); Retevis H777
modulation: FM analog (ch 1-8 analog) + dPMR FDMA 6.25 kHz (ch 9-16 digital)
notes: 16 analog channels (446.00625-446.19375 MHz) + 32 digital sub-channels (dPMR/DMR). No repeaters allowed. EU-harmonised: no licence needed. NOT legal outside CEPT area without local authorisation.

typical_devices: Motorola T600 FRS; Midland X-Talker T71VP3; Uniden SX507; BaoFeng BF-F8HP (GMRS capable); Motorola DLR1020 (DECT 1.9 GHz) — note: distinct from FRS; GMRS repeaters (licensed)
modulation: FM analog (FRS 12.5 kHz); CTCSS/DCS squelch tones
regulatory_ref: FCC Part 95 Subpart B (FRS) / Subpart E (GMRS)
notes: 22 FRS channels: ch 1-7 (462.5625-462.7125 MHz) + ch 8-14 (467.5625-467.7125 MHz) + ch 15-22 shared FRS/GMRS. GMRS requires FCC licence ($35). Flipper Zero Sub-GHz can monitor FRS channels.
